description: This file provides utility functions for image processing, including SVG to PNG conversion, content type detection, and image resizing, primarily using the 'sharp' library.

methods.name: convertSvgToPng
methods.description: Converts an SVG image (base64 encoded) to PNG format, with size check and fallback placeholder.

methods.name: detectContentType
methods.description: Detects the image content type from a buffer, supporting JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, SVG, AVIF, with fallback to sharp metadata detection.

methods.name: resizeImage
methods.description: Resizes an image buffer to specified dimensions while preserving the original format, using format-specific optimization.
